compiled_state.title: GREEN: Generate inference-incidents.jsonl corpus (>=20 records)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Manually curate 20 or more JSONL records representing observed inference incidents from ticket history.

File to create:
- tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/incidents.jsonl

Each record must have all 5 fields per inference-incident-schema.md:
- ticket_id: string matching ^[a-z0-9]{4}-[a-z0-9]{4}$
- inferred_decision_text: the decision the LLM inferred without explicit user input
- affects_fields: enum value from: title, description, acceptance_criteria, done_definitions, tags
- outcome: what happened as a result (e.g., planning-error, correct-inference, user-corrected)
- source_decision_text: the original ticket text that led to the inference

Sources for incidents: review ticket history in .tickets-tracker/, look for cases where implementation-plan or sprint made a decision not explicitly stated in the ticket (priority inference, scope inference, timing inference, dependency inference).

AC: jq -s 'length' tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/incidents.jsonl returns >= 20. All ticket_ids match format regex. All records have 5 required fields. test_corpus_file_has_minimum_incidents and test_corpus_ticket_ids_match_format pass. RED marker for incidents.jsonl remains in .test-index until T6b removes it.

comments.body: PLAN_AMENDMENT: Create the fixture directory before writing the corpus file: mkdir -p tests/fixtures/inference-incidents/. Hash function for holdout partition (used in T6b): Python hashlib.md5(ticket_id.encode()).hexdigest(), take first 8 hex chars as int (int(hash[0:8], 16)), then mod 3. Document this in a comment at the top of holdout.txt so it is reproducible.
